top_results.title: Graduation Requirements
top_results.chunk_text: In order to graduate from undergraduate programs, students applying for graduation must meet all the conditions specified in the Sabancı University Undergraduate Regulations. (Click here for the Sabancı University Undergraduate Regulations.) Students must have completed at least their last two semesters as full-time students at Sabancı University. The required SU credits and ECTS credits for graduation from the enrolled diploma program must be completed. (Graduation tracking should be done via the "Degree Evaluation" form in the Information System.) Both the Cumulative GPA (CGPA) and the Program GPA must be at least 2.00. Additionally, students who started their studies in the Foundations Development Year (FDY) must successfully complete the TLL 001 course. (As of the 2020-2021 Academic Year, the content of TLL 001 has been included in TLL 101 and TLL 102, which are offered at the undergraduate level, and will no longer be provided as a separate course. For students admitted before the 2020-2021 Academic Year, this requirement remains in effect, and the course will continue to be offered.) Important Notes Failed courses, as well as language courses for students in the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences, are not included in the Degree Evaluation Form. However, while these courses are included in the Cumulative GPA (CGPA), they are not included in the Program GPA.

query: What is the minimum passing grade of a course

top_results.title: Grading System
top_results.chunk_text: GRADING SYSTEM Grades are given on a scale of 4.00. The grades and grading symbols applicable to all programs are as follows: Letter Grade Grade Points A 4 A- 3.7 B+ 3.3 B 3 B- 2.7 C+ 2.3 C 2 C- 1.7 D+ 1.3 D 1 F 0 Other Grading Symbols: P : Progressing (For students continuing their work in courses not included in the GPA) S : Satisfactory (Passed in courses not included in the GPA) SL : Granted to students who achieve satisfactory performance on the English Language Proficiency Exam. EL : Granted to students exempt from the English Language Proficiency Exam. U : Unsatisfactory (Failed in courses not included in the GPA) UL : Granted to students who do not achieve satisfactory performance on the English Language Proficiency Exam. I : Incomplete (Result of an unfinished course or missed exam) T : Transfer (Courses transferred from another educational institution) W : Withdrawn NA : Non Attendance (Failed due to absenteeism, functions similarly to an F/U grade) To pass a course at the undergraduate level, the minimum passing grade is D for courses included in the GPA and S for courses not included in the GPA. To pass a course at the graduate level, the minimum passing grade is C for courses included in the GPA and S for courses not included in the GPA. Calculation of Grade Point Averages The total score you receive for a course is obtained by multiplying the course's SU credit by the grade point value of the grade earned. For example, a student who receives a "B" in a 3 SU credit course will have a total score of 3 * 3.0 = 9.0. top_results.chunk_text: Conditions of repeating a course is stated as below. Students who get an 'F', 'U', 'NA' or 'W' grade for University Courses offered in first year of education ; must take the subject course again in the following first semester it is given. Students who get an 'F', 'U', 'NA' or 'W' grade for elective or courses dropped from the curriculum, should take a substitute course approved by his/her advisor. For students who complete all courses offered in his/her diploma programs and other graduation requirements; this condition is not required. Students may repeat the courses in which they received passing grades ( (A, A-, B+, B, B-, C+,C, C-, D+, D) within 3 semesters at maximum following the semester they have taken it. The periods of semester leave and summer semester are not included in the semester counts. In the calculation of CGPA*, the previous point received for the repeated courses is replaced with the new point however all the registered courses of the student are shown in the transcript. * CGPA is calculated with SU credits.
